facts.text: Bensenville takes its name from Bensen, Germany, a village in Sudwalde, reflecting its early settlers’ heritage.
The village was formally founded in 1873 as Bensenville, after the Milwaukee Road railroad line ran through the area.
Victory Auto Wreckers on Green Street has been the backdrop for Chicago’s famous “door‑falling‑off‑the‑car” commercial since 1981.
Churchville School, a historic 19th‑century building, earned a spot on the National Register of Historic Places for its architectural significance.
The Bensenville Historical Society houses a large collection of local history materials at the Bensenville Library, welcoming curious visitors.
A scene from the 1990 film Flatliners was filmed at the old green house beside Blackhawk Junior High School in Bensenville.
